const definition: ToolDefinition = {
  name: 'escalate_to_human',
  description: 'Eskaler samtalen til et menneske, når agenten ikke kan svare på kundens spørgsmål.',
  inputSchema: {
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      reason_category: {
        type: 'string',
        enum: [...REASON_CATEGORIES],
      },
    },
    required: ['reason_category'],
  },
};

export function createEscalateToHumanTool(recorder: EscalationMarker) {
  const execute: ToolExecutor = async (input, context?: ToolContext) => {
    // HAL Engine validates input against inputSchema's enum before this runs, so an invalid category never arrives (FR-007).
    const reason = input['reason_category'] as ReasonCategory;
    if (context?.sessionId === undefined) {
      return 'Eskalering kunne ikke registreres, fordi samtalen mangler et sessions-id.';
    }
    recorder.mark(context.sessionId, String(context.userId), reason);
    return 'Eskalering er registreret. En medarbejder vil kontakte kunden hurtigst muligt.';
  };
  return {definition, execute};
}

content.text: {"answer": "Otto's `escalate_to_human` tool takes a single input object with one required string property, `reason_category`. The tool's input schema (`apps/api/src/tools/escalateToHuman/tool.ts`) restricts it to an enum, `REASON_CATEGORIES`. The spec (`specs/support-agent-escalation/spec.md`) lists three values for it: `no_tool_for_question`, `customer_asked_for_human`, and `out_of_scope_change_request`. I did not read the `REASON_CATEGORIES` constant itself, so I'm relying on the spec notes and a code-review note that the spec values match `tool.ts`. No other input fields are defined. HAL Engine validates the input against the enum before the tool runs, so an invalid category never reaches it. The session ID and user ID are not tool inputs. They come from the execution context (`context.sessionId`, `context.userId`). If the session ID is missing, the tool returns an error message instead of recording the escalation.", "sources": ["apps/api/src/tools/escalateToHuman/tool.ts", "specs/support-agent-escalation/spec.md (FR-002, FR-006, Key Entities; line 14)"]}
